title: VTX Platform Events Schema
description: Event formats emitted by the VTX platform over SSE and internal message brokers

ExecutionIntentCreatedV1.description: Payload persisted to outbox_events.payload for event_type execution_intent.created.v1 (VTX-2 → VTX-3). changelog_id is the Jira changelog.id — NOT a Jira workflow transition ID. occurred_at is the Jira webhook envelope timestamp normalized to UTC; occurred_at_source records whether it came from the webhook timestamp or fell back to the intake received_at.

issue_id.description: Authoritative Jira issue.id (re-fetched, never trusted from the payload)

changelog_id.description: Jira changelog.id of the accepted status transition

target_status_id.description: changelog `to` status ID; always a configured start_status_id
